descriptions.w3d_g3a_wrap_text_80289a34: Loads the front-end font, sets its size and text, splits newline and width-limited words into external twenty-byte line records, accumulates character counts and widths, and centers the resulting line positions vertically. Releases font and temporary lookup handles with native scoped lifetimes. Font, card UI and line-record semantics are inferred from original operations.
